title: Practice 2: The family of пасть (попа́сть, упа́сть)

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **попался** — попа́сться (perfective): to get caught; (colloquial, impersonal) to come across, to chance upon, to meet. Wiktionary: попа́сть + -ся.
